config.candidate_status: only previously attempted learner-matched candidate, development gate failed; retained as fixed negative candidate for prescribed evaluation, never described as a winning candidate
config.candidate_check_worlds: unused check worlds omitted from deployment computation; same selection worlds and choice rule, no change to action policy
config.reference_availability: R sampled within initial feature pool, groups excluded from all observed labels and arrivals; no future outer-test features
config.approval: same D0-trained tuned XGB business model fixed through replay, threshold .5; price=business_PD*exposure; B=rho*rejected_pool_cost
config.preprocessing: fit only permitted D0; each inner validation fold refits its own preprocessor
config.acquisition_parameter_search: none; one fixed acquisition configuration per method from completed development; do not tune on current hidden labels
config.neighbor_backend: explicit common-feature Laplace/cost/pending adaptation, not upstream NUTS
config.outer_non_temporal_split: two registered stratified group 5-fold repeats; available entity IDs plus exact feature duplicates grouped
config.lendingclub_time_split: use separately preserved loan ID and issue_d; 5 strictly forward disjoint-month windows per repeat; repeat0 initial 4 months, repeat1 initial 5 months; remaining months partitioned into five windows
config.lendingclub_arrivals: chronological issue month, random ties within month; immediate label revelation retrospective assumption, not strict online maturity validation
config.scope: internal repeated full-process evaluation on previously inspected datasets; not new external institution or first blind test
config.delta: 0.5% of old development fixed OrdinaryOnly ALC Brier, frozen before new outcomes; .1%/1% sensitivity
config.uncertainty: complete paired fold/repeat/stream effects; optional applicant-group paired test resampling conditional on fitted models; never iid t-test over 20 correlated folds or claim full training uncertainty
